reviews.comment: Really easy class as long as you show up (there are random in class assignments sometimes). The projects are straightforward and the 2 online exams were a breeze. Her instructions can be a little unclear sometimes but she's always open to questions and super flexible with deadlines.

This course is fairly easy. There's only 3 projects that are straightforward, no exams. She does give random class assignments so I would definitely attend class, since there are few things graded if you miss a few they can drop your grade quickly. Overall she's nice and it's straightforward course
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I'm not sure why prof. song has a low rate on here, she was one of the most laidback and easy going profs I've had. attendance isn't for a grade but we had random in-class activities so I would recommend going. 3 projects- no exams. Shes easy to reach, a fair grader, and the sweetest little lady you'll ever meet.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Comm 230 with Song is the easiest class I've ever taken. You do have to go to class because there are random assignments, but they are incredibly easy. Only 3 projects, and you have awhile to make them. Can't stress enough how easy this is as long as you show up.

Professor Song is an extremely nice professor and very easy grader. She is so sweet and understanding of outside commitments. This class was not bad and often fun. You should go to class as often as possible because she does often assign random assignments and if you miss it you get a zero. Overall good class!

This class was a breeze. Attendance was not mandatory but you could miss an in-class assignment if you don't go (there were not that many of them). Two major projects and they are worth more than the exams and super easy!! 2 online exams open book. You can't fail this class.

Very, very easy. Just show up to class because she gives random assignments and put in effort into your 3 projects and it will be a breeze. Professor Song is also very understanding if you talk to her in advance!
Easy class overall but there is one 15 page research paper that makes up 60% of your grade and the other 40% is quizzes.

If you want to take a very easy class, this is your best choice. However, her lectures are boring at best. You feel like you never really learn anything, but I would not blame it all on Ms. Song since she teaches the material required for the class which feels like it has no point. She is a lovely person and will help you out if you need anything.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: If you want an easy A take this class. There are three major projects that make up the class. The projects are easy varying from video production, logo creation and etc. Her lecture do get a bit boring and time feel like it couldn't move any faster, but she's a good professor. There are random in-class assignments so it's best to come to class.

if you want an easy class this is it. The professor was nice, but the content wasn't always super interesting. you get 3 video projects and they progressively get longer, but you get to choose out of a variety of things and your own topics. Making the videos was fun and if you need help she will give feedback. She tries to make it enjoyable too

Professor Song is a good choice! Lectures can be a bit dull at times, but they are still informative. Clear criteria for 3 individual projects (she even shows examples of what she wants). Just those 3 + some easy participation assignments. Not a tough grader. She is very easy to get in touch with and gives good feedback. Plus, she is a nice person!
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She's a really nice professor and there are no exams. You have to go to class to take notes for the random quizzes, but they're not hard. One final paper that was 15 pages with three other classmates. Overall not a hard class, just boring.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I would not recommend Professor Song, she gave me a high grade on the first speech and then the second speech I got a 60, she did not help when I asked her what I did wrong and was not understanding at all, she then graded my last two speeches low as well. It was on online class, and her modules and grading criteria were not clear at all. Stay away

I took her class for COMM 203 as an online minimester and she was great! I got a straight 100 in her class. I met with her on zoom multiple times to go over my speech outlines and ideas, very helpful!!! If you don't reach out to her you won't do well!! Best professor I have ever had, hands down.

Made a 97 on the first speech and a 24 on the second. I thought I made an A on the second speech. The criteria is unclear and she does not explain anything well. She does not respond to emails in time. Since I didn't know I was doing my speeches wrong I also failed the third one. When asking her why I did so bad she was rude and not understanding.

Professor Song is so nice, and she is one of the coolest professors at TAMU. Projects take up most of the course, but they have good instructions, and she is a very fair grader. I would recommend taking her if you are a communication major/minor, or you're looking to fill an elective credit.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Super sweet lady and very fair grader. Lectures can get pretty boring, but the class is easy. Main grades are a few projects, so just do those and you're fine. I'd definitely recommend her if you plan on taking the course.

I kinda put this class on the back burner because it was so easy. I would just attend class and take detailed notes and then the weekly quizzes are word for word from notes but she doesn't upload slides so you have to be there. There are no exams, only 1 group research paper but its a fun subject. I really recommend this class
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: She was so sweet & always willing to hear the class and try to help us with assignments in any way she could. The majority of your grade is a group research paper which isn't an issue just try to pick group members carefully. Take her if you can.

God tier, best professor I've taken in college. She is very sweet and really cares about the material she is teaching. Her accent can be hard to understand at times, but if you actually try and get to know her shes a gem. Literally the only reason you don't get an A in her class is if you don't try or don't show improvement. Also, show up to class!

Super sweet and class was very easy. Only a few video projects throughout the semester that don't require too much effort as long as you try. Accent can be kind of hard to understand but she is very easy to work with and if you're confused on anything you can email her or go to office hours. Great easy a class.

Professor Song is very sweet, but her class was kinda confusing. Half of the class is made of a group project done outside of class, she was not specific on the requirements or anything, just that its a 10 page research paper with 4 other classmates. There are no exams.

She is passionate about what she does, but it's honestly hard to understand what she wants from you for your projects. There's usually a project due every monday, and they're fun and easy to do. They're also your only grades besides attendance. It's her first year teaching, so I'm sure she'll get better each year! Overall she's okay and very kind.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Song always gave lectures that were pointless and didn't add anything to the class. The speeches were super easy as long as you put a few hours into them before hand (I usually wrote mine the day before). She couldn't answer questions well and if you miss class too many times she'll drop your grade. This sucks because it feels pointless

Easy A if you can give a decent speech, she doesn't grade hard, I have gotten pretty good grades on my speeches and I am not amazing, she really gives you a good grade if you put in the effort, people tend to skip class which doesn't help, and she is pretty serious about it. If you put in the effort to prepare then you will enjoy this class
